messages:
alex: Heads-up — canary started failing tokenization on long prompts in eu-west1. Observed ~3% error rate and some latency spikes. Proposing a surgical hotpatch.

devbot: :rotating_light: Deploybot notice: artifact rdi-infer:v2.3.9-hotfix queued for eu-west1. Reason: canary regression (tokenizer/kvcache mismatch). Required approvals: 2 infra / 1 product. To pin and start:```/deploy start --artifact rdi-infer:v2.3.9-hotfix --region eu-west1 --canary 5% --runbook https://redwood/runbooks/hotfix-kv-tokenizer```

ashley: ETA to get approval + release note blurb? This is customer-impacting for embeddings ingest. Need <30m window.

maria: on it. Can you paste a short release note line I can sign off? Also need rollback criteria — what do we watch?

alex: Rollback if errors >5% over 5m or p50 latency +200ms vs baseline. Also abort if canary fails more than 2/3 healthchecks.

ashley: Release note draft: "rdi-infer: fix tokenization edge case causing sporadic failed requests on long contexts; restores kvcache alignment."
maria: looks fine. signing off on release note. :+1:

sre_oncall: Quick telemetry check pls — please ensure trace sampling and kvcache metrics enabled for the rollout. If possible, temporarily increase log-level for tokenizer to DEBUG for canary pods only.

alex: doing a config patch now to enable debug on canary only. Pushing config:```kubectl apply -f canary-debug.yaml --namespace=eu-west1-infer```

devbot: Approval request: @release_manager please +1, @maria product signoff received. Current approvers: maria (product). Waiting for second infra approver.

release_manager: Reviewing runbook and rollback criteria. I can approve to start but holding auto-rollforward until metrics stable for 20m. +1 to start.

ashley: tagging oncall infra: @sre_oncall — can you second infra approval?

sre_oncall: +1, I've verified traces are routing and kvcache metrics are flowing. Ready to go.

devbot: Command executed:```/deploy start --artifact rdi-infer:v2.3.9-hotfix --region eu-west1 --canary 5% --runbook https://redwood/runbooks/hotfix-kv-tokenizer --pin rdi-infer:v2.3.9-hotfix```

alex: Canary pods launching. Monitoring now.

(devbot): Deploybot: Canary 5% deployed (3 pods). Healthchecks: 3/3. Observability link: https://observability/redwood/deploy/1754129000

maria: Checked release note snippet, added to changelog and customer-facing incident note. cc: @support-team

sre_oncall: Telemetry looks clean so far. Error rate back to baseline in canary. Holding for 20m stable window per runbook.

release_manager: Acknowledge. If stable, proceed to staged rollout to 25% then 100% after signoffs.

(devbot): Deploybot: Canary stable for 20m. Proceeding to 25% staged rollout.

alex: Rolling to 25% now. I'll keep an eye on latency and error spikes.

(devbot): Deploybot: Staged rollout 25% complete. No regressions detected. Next: 100% rollout in 10m unless abort.

ashley: Publishing release note and short internal blurb. Thanks all. :rocket:

(devbot): Deploybot: Full rollout complete. Artifact rdi-infer:v2.3.9-hotfix is pinned in eu-west1. Release notes: "Fix tokenization edge case causing sporadic failed requests on long contexts; restores kvcache alignment."

alex: Closing thread — will open followup if anything crops up. Good job team. :tada:
